title: Malmgren investigates for Kennedy administration, visits Lawrence Gise of the AEC
place_text: Albuquerque / Sandia National Laboratories, New Mexico

tellings.quote:
so he then as a result of that goes and
visits Loris Lawrence G or Geese um
who's Jeff Bezos's maternal grandfather
and the Albuquerque director of the
atomic energy commission

plain: In 1962, a man named Harold Malmgren was looking into something for President John F. Kennedy's administration. As part of that, Malmgren is said to have visited Lawrence Preston Gise, the Albuquerque director of the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency then in charge of nuclear work, and the maternal grandfather of Amazon founder Jeff Bezos. Michels tells this himself in an episode with a former Senate staffer named Kirk McConnell. He uses it to tie a White House inquiry to the nuclear world in New Mexico.
